spans.s: 1. ऋक्ष॑ mfn. (etym. doubtful) bald, bare, TS.; MaitrS.
2. ऋ॑क्ष mfn. (√ 2. ऋष्, Uṇ. iii, 66; 67; probably fr. √ ऋश्), hurting, pernicious, RV. viii, 24, 27
a bear (as a ravenous beast), RV. v, 56, 3; VS. xxiv, 36; Mn.; Suśr. &c.
a species of ape, Kathās.
Bignonia Indica, L.
N. of several men, RV. viii, 68, 15; MBh. &c.
of a mountain, VP.; MBh.
(ifc.) the best or most excellent, L.
pl. the seven stars, the Pleiades, the seven Ṛṣis, RV. i, 24, 10; ŚBr. ii; TĀr.
n. a star, constellation, lunar mansion, Mn.; MBh.; R. &c.
the twelfth part of the ecliptic
the particular star under which a person happens to be born, VarBṛS.; Sūryas. &c.

etym.s: [cf. Gk. ἄρκτος; Lat. ursus; Lith. loky-s for olkys.]

spans.s: 3. ऋक्ष mfn. cut, pierced, L.
N. of a wife of Ajamīḍha, MBh. i
of a woman in the retinue of Skanda, MBh. ix
a female bear, MBh.; R.; Kathās.
ऋक्ष—कर्णी f. N. of a Yoginī, Hcat.
ऋक्ष—गन्धा f. Argyreia Argenteia, L.
Batatas Paniculata, L.
ऋक्ष—गन्धिका f. Batatas Paniculata, L.
ऋक्ष—गिरि m. the mountain called Ṛkṣa.
ऋक्ष—ग्रीव m. ‘bear-necked’, a kind of demon, AV. viii, 6, 2.
ऋक्ष—जिह्व n. (scil. कुष्ठ) ‘like a bear-tongue’, a kind of leprosy, Car.
ऋक्ष—नाथ m. ‘lord of the stars’, the moon.
ऋक्ष—पति m. lord of the bears, R.
a planet presided over by a lunar mansion, VarBṛS.
ऋक्ष—बिल n. N. of a cavern, R. (B.)
ऋक्ष—मन्त्र m. a Mantra or text addressed to the lunar mansions.

ऋक्ष—राज् and ऋक्ष—राज, m. the lord of the bears (or apes ?), Hariv.; R.; BhP.;
 ‘lord of the stars’, the moon, Vikr.

ऋक्ष—राज् and ऋक्ष—राज, m. the lord of the bears (or apes ?), Hariv.; R.; BhP.;
 ‘lord of the stars’, the moon, Vikr.
ऋक्ष—वत् m. N. of a mountain, R.; Ragh. v, 44.
ऋक्ष—वन्त n. N. of a town, Hariv.
ऋक्ष—वर्ण mfn. bear-coloured, MBh.
ऋक्ष—विडम्बिन् m. ‘deceiving by means of the stars’, a fraudulent astrologer, VarBṛS.
ऋक्ष—विभावन n. observation of the stars.
ऋक्ष—हरीश्वर m. lord of the bears and apes, N. of Sugrīva, Ragh. xiii, 72.
‘lord of the stars’, the moon, L.
offering to the stars, Mn. vi, 10.
N. of a mountain, Kāś. on Pāṇ. iv, 3, 91.
N. of an evil spirit, AV. xii, 1, 49; VS. xxx, 8; ŚBr. xiii.
See p. 225, col. 1.
ऋ॑क्—षम (ऋ॑क्षम, TS. iv, 3, 2, 2) n. ‘similar to a Ṛc’, N. of a Sāman.
ऋक्—सम = -षम above, VS. xiii, 56.
ऋक्—साम॑ ए, n. du. the Ṛc verses and the Sāmans, RV. x, 114, 6; AV. xiv, 1, 11; VS.; ŚBr. &c.
(probably fr. √ ऋश्) a thorn (see अन्-ऋक्षर॑)
a priest, Uṇ. iii, 75 (fr. √ ऋष्)
a shower, L.
the part of an animal's leg between the fetlock joint and the hoof, VS. xxv, 3 (cf. ऋच्छ॑रा.)
ऋक्—छस् and ऋक्—शस्, ind. verse by verse, one Ṛc verse after the other, AitBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.; Gobh. &c.
ऋक्—शस् See -छस् above.
ऋक्—संशित mfn. sharpened by Ṛc verses (cf. आशासंशित), AV. x, 5, 30.
ऋक्—संहिता f. the Saṃhitā (q.v.) of the Ṛg-veda, Mn. xi, 262.
ऋक्—साम—शृङ्ग m. N. of Viṣṇu, R.
ऋक्—सामन् n. N. of a Sāman (= ऋ॑क्षम ?).
ऋक्—स्था mfn. consisting of Ṛc verses, TāṇḍyaBr. xvi, 8, 4.
